message: それでも僕は本を取る

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh. A demon you've never seen before, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. It was kind of like a cat demon.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not a panda?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't lump the great me in with small-fry demons!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you basically the same thing?」

name: Paqy
message: 「How?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I guess there could be demons that look like pandas too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Who knows. There's all kinds of 'em, just like humans.」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, I'm telling you, you're bothering the students!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, it's Misa. Wonder what she's doing.」
「I was merely lured by the alluring fragrance radiating from this garden of lovely maidens, letting my instincts guide my feet...」

name: Misa
message: 「Like I said, I can't possibly let a pervert onto the academy grounds!」
「Ahh, yet even that furious visage flushed crimson is as lovely as a rose, is it not?」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr! Excuse me for being so thorny!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「What?!」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Good morning...」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh, sorry about that. Good morning, Sakura-kun, Nanaka-san.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you doing so early in the morning?」

name: Misa
message: 「This person was trying to barge into the academy without permission, so I was warning him off.」
「However, frolicking with wonderful women is my very raison d'etre. The universal truth itself, so to speak.」

name: Misa
message: 「He's been going on like this the whole time...」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you looking for a wonderful woman?」
「Yes. I yearn for one from the very depths of my heart.」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, there's a wonderful person named Reiko Shinagawa at Shinagawa Greengrocer in the shopping district.」
「Oh, Lady Reiko! Truly magnificent!」
「From her name alone, one can easily imagine what a lovely woman she must be!」
「Thank you very much for the introduction.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, it's no trouble at all.」
「By the way, might I ask for your name, good sir?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I'm Synn Sakura, president of the Ryuusei Student Council.」
「Synn Sakura. So you are the president. You are quite charming yourself, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, thanks...」

name: Melphas
message: 「I am Melphas, the Evangelist of Love. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Now then, please excuse me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nice one, Synn. I can't believe you sicced him on Shina-oba...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'll have to apologize to Shina-oba later.」

name: Misa
message: 「You saved me, Sakura-kun. For today, I'll let you have my thanks.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, thanks.」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, we'll be late if we don't hurry.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, that's bad! Let's go, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's up? Something wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's just that Melphas guy...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, yeah, he's a demon, that one.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right?」
Just as I thought, there seem to be all kinds of demons.

name: Ria
message: 「And so, I'd like to begin the Crusaders' strategy meeting~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Specifically, what shall we be discussing?」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't it about the demon Sakura-kun said he saw yesterday?」

name: Synn
message: 「Since around last week, it's been every single day lately.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, would handling things the same way we have until now not suffice?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't ask me, I wouldn't know!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, we don't even know much about Re-Crea to begin with, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not something to say so proudly.」

name: Synn
message: 「The damage caused by demons is increasing.」

name: Synn
message: 「However, it's also a fact that we lack information...」

name: Ria
message: 「So first, everyone needs to properly learn about Re-Crea, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, do you have a bright idea?」

name: Ria
message: 「Um... for now, how about we ask my big sister?\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「And so, we've come to consult with you, Helena-san.」

name: Ria
message: 「I want you to teach everyone what you know, Big Sis.」

name: Helena
message: 「I see. I understand the situation.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then right away, the secrets of Re-Crea...」

name: Helena
message: 「Rejected!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We got turned down!?」

name: Helena
message: 「No good, you lot, relying on others so easily like that.」

name: Helena
message: 「You see, knowledge only sticks when you learn it yourself. It's just like studying.」

name: Misa
message: 「Certainly, that's true...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's such a hassle!」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't be spoiled」

name: Helena
message: 「Back in the day, even I gathered information all on my own and survived Re-Crea」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll lend you a hand when push comes to shove, so until then, try your best on your own」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis... You actually sound like an educator for once」

name: Helena
message: 「Saying things like that... Is it these boobs?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaah!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Honestly, what am I going to do if you don't pull yourself together」

name: Ria
message: 「B-But... I just thought you could tell us what Mom taught you...」

name: Helena
message: 「Shut up!」

name: Ria
message: 「Nooo~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, where on earth are we supposed to go to look up info on Re-Crea?」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see... For starters, why don't you try going to the library or something」

name: Helena
message: 「I relied on it quite a lot myself」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, of course」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, gathering information is the basics of any RPG!」

name: Helena
message: 「In terms of trying hard on your own first, don't you think it's just right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. So that is why you all came here together」

name: Synn
message: 「We were hoping you could lend us some materials regarding Re-Crea」
Knowing Melilot-san, she's bound to pick out the exact right materials for us.

name: Melilot
message: 「Acquiring new knowledge to prepare for the future...」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is a truly admirable attitude」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ahem!」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, it is unnecessary」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I mean that there is no need for you all to gather information about Re-Crea」

name: Ria
message: 「Then what should we do from here on out……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, exactly. Fighting without knowing anything is kinda weird, isn't it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You will come to learn the necessary knowledge in due time, once the moment arrives」

name: Melilot
message: 「Until then, you need not force yourselves to gather information」

name: Melilot
message: 「Instead, I simply ask that you devote that time to other matters you ought to be doing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Like going on adventures and having tea parties!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Your regular studies and special training in Spirit Arts」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heuuu, so it's all just troublesome stuff after all……」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, is it really unnecessary……?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am not forbidding it, necessarily」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is simply that you all have other things you ought to prioritize」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Doesn't this feel subtly different from what Helena told us?」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, as long as Melilot says so, I suppose it can't be helped」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe Big Sis predicted that things would turn out like this too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good grief, she completely pulled the wool over our eyes」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, something wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah. Just forgot something」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone, go on ahead without me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gotcha」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh, Sakura-kun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you still need something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes」

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking of doing some research on Re-Crea」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Is that so」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like you're forbidding it, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Please feel free to do as you like, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, I'll gladly take you up on that offer」

name: Synn
message: 「There might just be some related documents mixed in among them, after all……」

name: Melilot
message: 「For better or worse, I suppose that just means you're earnest……」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, that's not a bad thing at all……」
First, I narrowed my focus to the previous Re-Crea and stuck it out right up until time ran out, but…….
In the end, I didn't get any decent results.
Maybe Melilot-san is right after all...

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes... huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Why don't you take a little break?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It wouldn't hurt to have at least a cup of tea」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, are you sure...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's a silly question. I'm the one offering it, after all」

name: Melilot
message: 「Overworking yourself won't get you anywhere」

name: Synn
message: 「...You're right」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, thank you very much」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Go right ahead」

name: Synn
message: 「...By the way, isn't eating and drinking prohibited in here...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is a special exception」

name: Melilot
message: 「Taking care of diligent students is also part of a librarian's duties, after all」
Still, I feel like trying just a little bit harder.
Because when all is said and done, Ms. Melilot stayed and watched over me right up until closing time...
